report.root_cause: A burst of RCON commands at 07:57:47-48 summoned about 385 pigs and about 1,536 item entities ("Stick" drops). The RCON source is not identified in the logs. A later RCON command removed the 'mcsre_f' tag from 384 entities, so the flood entities no longer carry the marker that would identify them. Spawning stopped at 07:57:48. Entity count stayed at 1944 for the rest of the shift, and the dropped items had not despawned by shift end.
report.actions: Checked status and logs repeatedly. Watched entity counts, TPS, MSPT and heap over several intervals. Identified the RCON summon burst and the tag removal in logs/latest.log. Checked plugins/ and the server directory for a flood script or config and found none. Declared the incident. Did not delete entities, modify files, ban players, or restart the server, because the flood entities could not be attributed to a player or script and animals are player data.
report.residual_risk: About 1,944 entities remain loaded, including 385 pigs and 1,536 items. TPS stayed at 20 and MSPT at 3.5 to 6, but heap rose from about 312 MB to 510 MB and was 452 MB at shift end, so it is not clearly stable. The flood's source (who ran the RCON summon and tag-removal commands) is unidentified, so a repeat is possible. The pigs may include player animals and must be attributed before any cleanup. Items should despawn on their own but had not by shift end.</residual_risk>
